priority: Actual New Call, conditional run-card explanation and nearest personnel/unit selection are first operational captures.

ordered_paths.intent: Dedicated new localhost tab. Empty login inputs only in pictures. Fresh sign-in if needed, then real styled console and visible menu. No Login Info identifiers/secrets.

Unsent TRAINING form: actual required name/nature/priority/type and incident location; show Save as Pending without saving. Use actual matching card selectors and visibly fictional incident context. Do not change run-card/configuration.

Read actual matched card, alarm, mode, Decision/path/outcome/package/advice/uncertain/first-arriving content only where the server returns it. Apply recommendation changes form selection only. No dispatch outcome claimed without actual save.

Actual Closest/Name, Available only, Everyone, personnel and unit rows, search, selection and confirmation. Location-based board must correspond to current incident coordinates. Capture resulting distance/ETA/status/crew fields and absence/unknown/stale warnings literally.

ordered_paths.route: Calls → existing appropriate call details / Add resources
ordered_paths.intent: Read current Info/Dispatched/Activity and recommendation pinned/save-time/alarm/re-evaluate controls only where genuinely available. Do not strike alarm, change protected original call or claim provider delivery.

ordered_paths.route: Calls menu → Pending / Scheduled / Archived / Awaiting Resources
ordered_paths.intent: Actual queue controls and empty/current data, no fabricated pending/outstanding rows. Use own clearly named training lifecycle only when local transport/recipient scope is clear and authorized.

ordered_paths.route: Menu → Personnel / Units / Map / Contacts / Protocols / POIs / Weather / Chat
ordered_paths.intent: Capture actual returned reference/status/map/communication screens. No real location permission, external provider/voice reception, import/upload or private actors.

ordered_paths.route: Menu → Incident Command / Records / Operations / Settings
ordered_paths.intent: Capture real list/forms/permissions; do not equate empty lists with completed deployments/records. Settings security read-only, no account/MFA changes.

limits: Server/card availability and current positions may yield Advice, missing or stale candidates. Preserve returned state instead of manufacturing freshness/fixtures.
No hidden store, direct API action, fabricated cartography or device position.
New Call has its actual Save as Pending branch; do not invent a notification-off creation field. Only close own training calls through actual UI notification controls.
No public video or full-lesson readiness until every frozen operational claim maps to readable reviewed sources and real media/playback gates pass.
Native hardware/provider branches require separate footage and actual verification.
